scenes.say: Meet Anand, a cab driver. Lately, at night, sign boards look blurry, and headlights feel blinding.

scenes.en: But vision often changes slowly, without you noticing.
scenes.say: He thought it was just tiredness. But vision often changes slowly, so you don't notice it.

scenes.en: Driving depends on your eyes. A small blur means a slower reaction.
scenes.say: When you drive, most of what you react to comes through your eyes. A small blur can mean a slower reaction.

scenes.en: Long hours, dust and AC air dry the eyes and blur vision.
scenes.ta: நீண்ட நேரம், தூசி, ஏசி காற்று கண்களை உலரச் செய்யும்
scenes.say: Did you know? Long hours on the road, dust, and air conditioning can dry your eyes, and make your vision blurry and tired.

scenes.en: Yearly eye test. Clean windscreen and glasses. A break every 2 hours.
scenes.ta: வருடம் ஒரு முறை கண் பரிசோதனை, 2 மணி நேரத்துக்கு ஒரு இடைவேளை
scenes.say: Now Anand gets his eyes checked every year, keeps his windscreen and glasses clean, and takes a short break every two hours.

scenes.big: See an eye specialist urgently if...
scenes.en: Sudden blur, double vision or loss of side vision.
scenes.ta: திடீர் மங்கல், இரட்டைப் பார்வை இருந்தால் உடனே கண் மருத்துவரிடம்
scenes.say: See an eye specialist urgently if you get sudden blur, double vision, or you lose side vision.

scenes.en: Auto, cab or bus: book your yearly eye test.
scenes.ta: வருடம் ஒரு முறை கண் பரிசோதனை செய்யுங்கள்
scenes.say: Auto, cab or bus, your eyes bring you home safely. Book your yearly eye test.
